A commit lead below about 2.1 s is not counted as a landing (LEAD 204 (1), GNC). When committed: MV latch and opener ramp (0.35 s) with the pintle seated; V1 and V2 open; both taps flow 2.5 s; the close command leads by the measured valve closing time so the flow stops by E0 - 0.05 s (scheduled flow end, LEAD line 164). Closure (V1 first, on P_mid) is confirmed by the closure deadline <= the torch gate (Electronics: E0 + 0.15 s), otherwise BLEED_FAULT (see E1). At the deadline without confirmation: flight - BLEED_FAULT to the FC (log-only, line 168), V2 commanded closed, the lift proceeds; stand - abort. Then the pintle is commanded to THE start-level lift h_s(T_tank at E0), the row of the ignition-lift table: 0.2039 mm at 20 C, 0.21776 mm at the A1 relight state 286.70 K (t_lift 28.7-29.5 ms); CF-3 calibrates the table to <= 37.1 g/s at 20 C and <= 37.4 g/s at the A1 state and measures at the commanded lift with the encoder recorded (start_level_lift_v2p4b; LEAD 203 (7)).
